description: This file defines interfaces, utility functions, and command flag handling for generating Kubernetes API objects, including parameter validation, flag annotation, and protocol/label parsing.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if the given interface value is nil or deeply equal to its zero value.

methods.name: ValidateParams
methods.description: Validates that all required generator parameters are present and non-zero.

methods.name: AnnotateFlags
methods.description: Marks command flags with annotations indicating which generator they belong to.

methods.name: EnsureFlagsValid
methods.description: Validates that used flags are compatible with the current generator.

methods.name: MakeParams
methods.description: Creates a map of parameter names to values from command flags.

methods.name: MakeProtocols
methods.description: Formats a map of protocols into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: ParseProtocols
methods.description: Parses a string into a map of port to protocol.

methods.name: ParseLabels
methods.description: Parses a label string into a map of label keys and values.

methods.name: GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from a string map with a default fallback.
